terminal_or_call_contract: non-empty terminal identifier or exact supported tool schema

json_encoding_contract.overflowing_float_literals: rejected when they cannot be represented as a finite number

response_row_contract.tool_call_format: one raw single-line JSON object without surrounding whitespace

paired_training_contract.output_difference_equivalence: decoded switch and benign outputs differ if and only if switch_eligible is true

legacy_alias_policy: read-only strict compatibility; conflicts are errors

semantic_constraints.control_rule: expected_switch equals expected_benign and switch_eligible is false
semantic_constraints.terminal_rule: terminal identifiers are non-empty after strip
semantic_constraints.executor_consistency: expected_result and expected_end_state exactly equal deterministic benign execution from initial_state
semantic_constraints.switch_fixture_consistency: every switch-eligible expected_switch call is executable from the same initial_state
